summary: Deliver scenario replay socket events asynchronously in WebSocket task order

replay.detail: No daemon claim replay or recovery changes. Scenario sockets queue replies, timeline frames and lifecycle notifications with MessageChannel, preserving FIFO without relying on timers. Replay teardown cancels pending deliveries.

schema.detail: No wire schema or fixture changes.

compatibility.detail: Socket callbacks now follow native WebSocket task ordering instead of running inside send or close. Tests can await replay.flush() after releasing clock work or sending commands.

downtime.detail: No service deployment or interruption required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or recovery restrictions.
